_note: This is a feed on the conduct of the medical industries. It is not a source
of medical advice, and the gate refuses health-and-wellness coverage,
symptom explainers and individual patient stories for that reason.
direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for regulators, inquiries and evidence reviews.
official  medicines regulators, courts, prosecutors, public inquiries
research  journals, evidence reviews, payments and pricing research
press     general news across the locales
rights    patient, access and privacy organisations
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: the BMJ, The Lancet, Cochrane,
Health Action International, Medicines Law & Policy, No Free Lunch, AllTrials,
Public Citizen's Health Research Group, and national medicines regulators.
